newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ITE Electric unit signs joint venture.
newsitem.headline: ITE Electric unit signs joint venture.

text.p: ITE Electric Co Ltd said on Wednesday its subsidiary Electech Distribution Systems Pte Ltd (Electech Singapore) had signed a joint venture agreement with Albrecht Jung Beteiligungs-GmgH (JUNG) and Kroning & Roth GmbH & Co KG, an associate of ITE Electric.
It said in a statement the three will operate a joint venture company in Singapore called Jung Asia Pte Ltd (JVCo), which will import, export and distribute products and components.
The venture company will have an authorised share capital of Singapore $2 million and a proposed issued and paid-up capital of S$500,000.
Electech Singapore will subscribe for a total of 220,000 ordinary shares of S$1 each in the capital of JVCo for cash at par, comprising 44 percent of the capital of the venture.
The balance of 51 percent will be held by JUNG and five percent by Kroning & Roth.
ITE Electric said the stake in the JVCo will enable the group to supplement its existing range of distribution and agency activities.
The deal will have no material impact on the company's net tangible assets and earnings per share for the financial year ending December 31, 1997.
